mapper.sql: from biz_research_group_member m inner join biz_research_group g on g.group_id = m.group_id where g.del_flag = '0' and g.status = '0' and m.status = '0'
mapper.select:
select count(1)
and m.group_id = #{groupId} and m.user_id = #{userId}

select count(1)
and m.group_id = #{groupId} and m.user_id = #{userId} and m.member_role = #{memberRole}

select count(1) from biz_research_group_member m inner join biz_research_group g on g.group_id = m.group_id inner join biz_research_group_unit u on u.group_id = m.group_id and u.dept_id = m.dept_id and u.status = '0' where g.del_flag = '0' and g.status = '0' and m.status = '0' and m.group_id = #{groupId} and m.dept_id = #{deptId} and m.user_id = #{userId}

select count(1) from biz_research_group_unit u inner join biz_research_group g on g.group_id = u.group_id where g.del_flag = '0' and g.status = '0' and u.status = '0' and u.group_id = #{groupId} and u.dept_id = #{deptId} and u.manager_user_id = #{userId}

select distinct m.group_id
and m.user_id = #{userId} and m.member_role = 'LEADER' order by m.group_id
select group_id from biz_research_group where del_flag = '0' and status = '0' order by group_id
